nights.title: Jai Wolf - Ages 18+
nights.name: Jai Wolf
nights.extract: Sajeeb Saha, known professionally as Jai Wolf, is a Bangladeshi-American DJ and producer. He is best known for his singles, "Indian Summer", "Like It's Over", and "Starlight". He is currently signed to Mom + Pop Music.

en.who: sajeeb saha, known professionally as jai wolf, is a bangladeshi-american dj and producer. he is best known for the singles "indian summer", "like it's over" and "starlight".

nights.title: Little Image: Fall 2026 Tour
nights.name: Little Image
nights.extract: Little Image are an American alternative pop band from Dallas, Texas. They released their major label debut, Self Titled, on Hollywood Records on May 12, 2023, after the independent release of Musings in 2017.

en.who: little image are an american alternative pop band from dallas, texas. they released their major label debut, self titled, on hollywood records after the independent release of musings in 2017.
facts: They released their major label debut, Self Titled, on Hollywood Records on May 12, 2023.
The independent release of Musings came in 2017, before their major label debut.

de.who: little image sind eine amerikanische alternative-pop-band aus dallas, texas. ihr major-label-debüt „self titled“ erschien am 12. mai 2023 bei hollywood records, nach der unabhängigen veröffentlichung von musings im jahr 2017.
facts: das major-label-debüt „self titled“ erschien am 12. mai 2023 bei hollywood records.
2017 erschien zunächst musings in unabhängiger veröffentlichung.

tr.who: little image, teksas'ın dallas kentinden amerikan bir alternatif pop grubudur. 2017'de bağımsız olarak çıkardıkları musings'in ardından major plak şirketi debut çalışması self titled'ı hollywood records ile yayımladılar.
